_why: Topics temporarily withheld from the daily rotation. Never a deletion: lib/features.mjs still knows every one of them, and removing an id from `paused` below puts it straight back in rotation with no other change. Each entry must say WHY and what would end the pause, so a pause can never quietly become permanent.

ask-dont-beg.why: Not an app capability. Its four steps are copywriting advice ('ask a question instead of begging for likes') and every one carries ui.screen compose/result — there is no app screen to photograph, so no screenshot can ever satisfy assertVisualProof's real-photo requirement. Confirmed by reading lib/features-demand.mjs.
ask-dont-beg.until: the topic is rewritten around a real Instagram screen, or retired
